name: Bollinger mean reversion in a range
idea: In a range regime, a signal when the close comes back inside the Bollinger bands after a close beyond the lower band (bullish) or the upper band (bearish); the idea is wrong beyond the excursion's extreme.

params.label: Band period
params.help: Bars in the average the bands are built around.

params.label: Band width
params.help: How many standard deviations the bands keep from their middle.

params.label: Range regime
params.help: What tells a range: ADX below its threshold, or the swing structure reading a range.
choice_labels: The swing structure is a range

params.label: ADX period
params.help: Bars the ADX is calculated over.

params.label: ADX threshold
params.help: Below this ADX level the market counts as ranging.

params.label: Swing size
params.help: For the swing structure: which swings count, 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger swings need more history.

params.label: The idea has ended
params.help: When the market touches the middle band, or the opposite band.
choice_labels: A touch of the middle band
A touch of the opposite band
